items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1961-06-21
items.q: Fowler's arranged them for the band

ctx.x: They recorded one of yours, Basin Street Stroller, and what was the other one you did? I didn't know. That was later. They didn't record that. Yeah, you did. I thought that the one out there in Portland, Oregon, what is the...

The Powell Powell? Fowler. No, I don't think he recorded it. He arranged it all right. He arranged a lot of things. I mean, the acetates of it, or... I mean, acetates, yes. I had two pretty good rags I wrote later that never got published. Fowler's arranged them for the band, but...
Oh, yeah, they were recorded up there. Weren't they by Fowler's band? Weren't they done in Portland?
